records.title: The twelve foundations
records.finding: The twelve statements define the investigator’s research charter.
records.limitation: A declared premise is not an empirical result.
records.next_test: Test concrete implementations against independent observations.

records.title: C-01: emission ceiling
records.finding: The origin of the local emission ceiling is a research objective; distinguish characteristic, group and front speeds.
records.limitation: No calibrated mechanism fixes the observed ceiling.
records.next_test: Derive a causal finite-source response with calibrated matter standards.

records.title: Screened common-field obstruction
records.finding: A-05c did not identify a stable joint parameter regime satisfying slowing, atomic spectra, lensing and multimessenger constraints.
records.limitation: Restricted to the investigated model family; not a general no-go theorem.
records.next_test: Derive a revised coupling and evaluate all constraints jointly.

records.title: Finite-source screening
records.finding: Finite-size suppression is weaker than the local-equilibrium estimate suggests.
records.limitation: Conditional bounds and illustrative numerical results, not measured field screening.
records.next_test: Solve finite 3D sources with shared atomic calibration.

records.title: Early recession-distance candidate
records.finding: Early recession-plus-slowing distance candidates encounter high-redshift size and drift tension.
records.limitation: Failure of these implementations does not establish an alternative distance law.
records.next_test: Fit held-out angle, timing, flux and spectrum data with shared parameters.

records.title: Conservative mode coupling and massive-vector sector
records.finding: Restricted analytical and numerical demonstrations include scalar coupling, Stueckelberg/Yukawa response and atomic shifts.
records.limitation: Not a measured photon rest mass or complete matter theory.
records.next_test: Predict static range, longitudinal modes and atomic spectra with one parameter set.

records.title: Moving atomic endpoints
records.finding: Autonomous one-dimensional separation and moving atomic endpoints give selected spectra dominated by motion.
records.limitation: Dimensionless toy, not calibrated cosmology.
records.next_test: Derive coupled source motion and detector response.

records.title: Packet reach versus causal reach
records.finding: Packet reach and causal reach differ; bounded scalar energy prevents eternal zero speed in the stated model.
records.limitation: A group-velocity result does not determine the signal front.
records.next_test: Derive stable characteristic and front behavior from the full local theory.

records.title: Reciprocal optical maps
records.finding: The static and axisymmetric optical audit finds a brightness-factor tension despite reciprocal maps and weak spherical defocusing.
records.limitation: No fitted cosmology or universal distance correction.
records.next_test: Predict luminosity and angular distances with one transport model.

records.title: C-01 shell and void control
records.finding: The candidate mass-sourced regulator yields a wave-speed law but fails monotone aging across the shell.
records.limitation: No detected cosmic wall; Newtonian shell force and regulator response are separate.
records.next_test: Develop a causal gap-history and recoil mechanism.

records.title: Passive fixed-gap drag
records.finding: For the stationary fixed-gap benchmark, modest redshift gives tiny speed change; identical stationary emission intervals are not stretched by the aging law.
records.limitation: Restricted fixed-gap, stationary-endpoint result.
records.next_test: Test a moving-endpoint or derived dynamical transport model against spectrum and timing together.

records.title: Fixed-gap wall energy bound
records.finding: For a gap fraction 10⁻¹⁶ and a 10% ceiling increase, the maximum retained energy fraction for nonincreasing endpoint speed is about 2.4004 × 10⁻¹⁶.
records.limitation: Necessary endpoint bound only; not a sufficient pathwise criterion.
records.next_test: Check energy retention and continuous trajectory sign together.

records.title: Linear-wall constant-drag conflict
records.finding: At gap fraction 0.1 and ceiling ratio 1.2, entry monotonicity requires drag ≥ 19.89975, whereas positive-speed traversal requires drag < 3.28345.
records.limitation: This rules out the selected constant-drag control, not all environmental models.
records.next_test: Derive and test a variable gap or history mechanism.

records.title: Finite-capacity history coordinate
records.finding: A selected reduced wall model adds a history coordinate with recoil, heat and wall-reaction ledgers, permitting a different crossing behavior.
records.limitation: Finite capacity and emission-energy dependence prevent a universal solution.
records.next_test: Derive microscopic dynamics with a causal receiver, not a stipulated history rate.

records.title: Bounded flow and reversible conversion
records.finding: Reduced controls include bounded flow, calibration, finite wall recoil and reversible local conversion.
records.limitation: Not one unified physical or observationally fitted theory.
records.next_test: Couple the models and calibrate independent source and receiver standards.

records.title: Contact conversion loses narrow-beam transport
records.finding: One-arcsecond idealized aperture accepts about 1.44456 × 10⁻¹³ of converted packets in the selected contact reference.
records.limitation: Conditional acceptance after conversion, not an astronomical optical depth or luminosity-distance fit.
records.next_test: Derive forward transport, actual detection and angular diffusion.

records.title: Continuous static-wall certificate
records.finding: The fine interval enclosure reports an upper derivative bound −0.05341 in the rising wall and a path speed lower bound 0.81507.
records.limitation: Only the original static reduced trajectory and parameter case; not an all-frequency or astronomical proof.
records.next_test: Independently verify intervals and extend to derived moving-wall dynamics.

records.title: LMC geometric anchor
records.finding: Review 6.0 reports the literature eclipsing-binary distance 49.59 kpc, statistical 0.09 and systematic 0.54 kpc.
records.limitation: Specific calibrated inference; quadrature arithmetic is not a new joint fit.
records.next_test: Preserve raw anchor observations and recalibrate any candidate correction.

records.title: NGC 4258 geometric anchor
records.finding: Review 6.0 reports the literature maser distance 7.576 Mpc, statistical 0.082 and systematic 0.076 Mpc.
records.limitation: No universal downward rescaling is inferred.
records.next_test: Recover the maser geometry with shared calibrated parameters.

records.title: Finite-range forward-transfer obstruction
records.finding: Large gap conversion has a nonzero forward-transfer floor; the near-degenerate example gives cone fraction about 0.8844 and mean retained energy 0.9999989997.
records.limitation: Born-level selected cases; near-degenerate transfer is minute and repeated scattering is unsolved.
records.next_test: Derive material structure factors, cumulative angular diffusion and optical depth.

records.title: Collinear phase-matched reservoir
records.finding: A selected coherent reservoir mode permits collinear phase-matched conversion, while finite-cell coupling has detuning and reverse-transition controls.
records.limitation: Coherence, material structure and physical rates are not derived or calibrated.
records.next_test: Derive a causal spatial reservoir and its spectral density.

records.title: Escape-assisted population criterion
records.finding: For the resonant selected-mode Markov model, κ ≥ 4G ensures nondecreasing total converted population.
records.limitation: Not a theorem of continuous slowing of individual photons; no incoming reservoir excitation assumed.
records.next_test: Derive a multimode reservoir with reverse channels and detector calibration.

records.title: Escape analytical-versus-ODE comparison
records.finding: Six escape ratios 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 at G=0.04 agree to maximum sampled absolute difference 1.54 × 10⁻¹³ after solver refinement.
records.limitation: Reported source comparison, not newly replicated here or physical validation.
records.next_test: Reproduce the full archived calculations and derive rates from material dynamics.

records.title: Review 6.0 numerical checks and warnings
records.finding: The forward script records 137 regression assertions. Three extreme elastic rows triggered quadrature warnings for small moment integrals; one selected refinement also warns.
records.limitation: The checks are not experiments; warned rows are illustrative, not precision-certified.
records.next_test: Retain warnings, reproduce the source archive, test nonperturbative limits.

records.title: Gravitational versus electromagnetic timing
records.finding: Review 6.0 quotes the published GW170817/GRB 170817A differential speed constraint of approximately −3 × 10⁻¹⁵ to +7 × 10⁻¹⁶.
records.limitation: Depends on emission-time and propagation assumptions; not a direct isotropic coordinate-speed bound.
records.next_test: Predict arrival lags with source, detector, clock and field parameters.

records.title: Unified observational completion
records.finding: No common calibrated observationally successful implementation is demonstrated in Review 6.0.
records.limitation: Passing restricted numerical controls does not establish an alternative cosmology.
records.next_test: Use held-out shared-parameter optical, timing, geometric and clock tests.
